toolchain.visualStudio: 2022 (17.10+) or Build Tools 18 with Desktop C++ + ATL/MFC

mediaAndDrm.widevineDistribution: User-consented external CDM directory registration; no proprietary Google CDM binaries committed to this repository. Redistribution requires a Google Widevine license agreement and patent-pool review.

patches.purpose: Expose WebContentsObserver::OnAudioStateChanged on CefDisplayHandler without muting audio.
patches.securityImpact: None; read-only boolean state callback on UI thread.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when upstream CEF exposes non-muting OnAudioStateChanged on CefDisplayHandler.

patches.purpose: Allow explicit user-consented Widevine CDM path registration without Google component updater background traffic.
patches.securityImpact: Low; validates manifest signature/path before passing to content::CdmRegistry; keeps sandboxed CDM utility process.
patches.removalCondition: Remove if upstream CEF provides a standalone Widevine registration API independent of component updater.

patches.purpose: Bind chrome.tabs.*, chrome.windows.*, and chrome.action badge updates natively to Zenith's Space, split-view, Glance, Essentials, and sleeping tab model.
patches.securityImpact: Medium; enforces permission redaction and per-profile/incognito isolation at the extension API boundary; reviewed at every CEF upgrade.
patches.removalCondition: Retain while Chromium's extension TabStripModel assumes a Chrome browser window rather than Zenith's host.

patches.purpose: Disable unsolicited Chromium ComponentUpdater (update.googleapis.com / edgedl.me.gvt1.com) and Search AIM eligibility (/async/folae) background requests identified by the Phase 4 idle network audit.
patches.securityImpact: None; removes unwanted background HTTP/HTTPS traffic without affecting sandbox, TLS, or user-initiated requests.
patches.removalCondition: Remove if upstream CEF exposes a runtime switch that completely disables shared_url_loader_factory component and omnibox background probes.
